drafts.name: Jane Researcher
drafts.paper_title: A Synthetic Benchmark for Reproducible AI Agents
drafts.subject: Research collaboration around Synthetic Benchmark Reproducible AI
drafts.body:
Dear Jane,

I am Example Sender, a researcher/engineer working on reproducible AI systems.

I came across your work on "A Synthetic Benchmark for Reproducible AI Agents" and was especially interested in the evaluation and reproducibility angle.

I would be glad to contribute to related research work, especially around benchmark implementation and analysis tooling.

GitHub: https://github.com/your-username
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/your-profile
CV: attached CV

Would you be open to considering whether I could contribute remotely to one of your ongoing projects?

Best,
Example Sender
